recognize_zh: 抹片中一群中型淋巴細胞，核圓或橢圓、染色質中度濃縮，部分可見單一明顯核仁，細胞質淡藍、邊緣毛糙不規則，符合毛細胞白血病變異型（核仁明顯是與典型 HCL 區別的線索）。
features: Cluster of intermediate-sized lymphoid cells with round to oval nuclei
Moderately condensed chromatin with a distinct central nucleolus in some cells
Moderate pale blue-gray cytoplasm with ragged, irregular borders suggesting fine projections
Occasional binucleate-appearing or indented nuclei within the cluster
Paucicellular background with scattered red cells, one small dark cell, and clear lipid-like spaces
describe_en: Smear shows a cluster of intermediate-sized atypical lymphoid cells in a paucicellular background containing clear lipid-like spaces, suggestive of an aspirate preparation. The cells have round to oval nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin, a conspicuous nucleolus in several cells, and moderate pale blue-gray cytoplasm with ragged borders. Normal hematopoietic elements are sparse in this field. Findings are consistent with involvement by hairy cell leukemia variant; immunophenotyping (CD25 and annexin A1 negative) and BRAF V600E testing are needed to exclude classic HCL.

ddx.vs: Classic hairy cells lack prominent nucleoli, often yield a dry tap, and are CD25/annexin A1/BRAF V600E positive.
Prolymphocytes have prominent nucleoli but scant cytoplasm without hairy projections and lack CD103/CD11c co-expression.
SMZL cells have more condensed chromatin, no prominent nucleoli and polar villi, and are CD103 negative.

ddx.dx: Mantle cell lymphoma, blastoid or pleomorphic
ddx.vs: MCL is CD5 and cyclin D1 positive with t(11;14), while cytoplasmic projections are not a feature.
